about: M18 (junctions and ramps: steeper and shorter ramps, every junction's legs held level or its surface carried, embankments under the low raised roads, signals and crosswalks by need) with M21 (cyberpunk massing: tower forms on base plates, true arcs) and M16 (water and ground detail: water beds and banks, ground cover) on M17 (road network repair: every dead end run on, tagged or cut back, junction cut-backs past every overlap, bend junctions, shared pavement; the four network checks) on sha256 of each sample city's city_model.json (citygen build output, M10 (stable ids: every id from what the entity is and where it sits, renamed by one pass before the props and at the end; blocks from the road pieces that touch a district, unioned along a Z-order merge tree, so a far change does not move them; the props, plants and gameplay layer draw on stable ids) on M12 on M9 and M11: M12 (stack and turbine interchanges; no sample has two highways crossing with room for one, so every model is the M9 and M11 one byte for byte apart from spec_sha256, which hashes the filled spec and so its new defaults highways.crossings and highways.named[].reuse) on M9 tunnels (nexus_city: a cut-and-cover tunnel under Midtown, peninsula_city: an immersed tube; the metro lowered under foundations, pedestrian underpasses) and M11 (the gameplay layer: points of interest, zones, wealth, danger and police fields, street densities, parking, travel points and sign slots, district params gain wealth, danger and police) on M8c on M8d: M8b on M8a, the trumpet with one loop and one flyover (M8d, only vesper_bay has a trumpet), and transit that passes on a city's first layout: flying loops as Dubins rings, open lines off the roads or as Dubins paths where the roads fail them (M8c); archipelago_free_port is unchanged from M8b). The same bytes on every machine with the pinned requirements: produced for M10 on M12, M9 and M11 (and before it M12 on M9 and M11, M11 on M9, M9, M11 and M8c) on the M4 Mac and, byte for byte, on x86_64 Linux (docker, linux/amd64); earlier milestones confirmed with GEOS 3.14.1 rebuilt with clang against libc++ (the C++ library of macOS builds) and with one worker and another PYTHONHASHSEED; traces of every stage are in docs/progress/M1b_det/ (M1b), docs/progress/M2/<city>/trace.json (M2), docs/progress/M3/<city>/trace.json (M3) and docs/progress/M3p/<city>/trace.json (M3p) docs/progress/M5/<city>/trace.json (M5) docs/progress/M6/<city>/trace.json (M6), docs/progress/M7/<city>/trace.json (M7a) docs/progress/M7b/<city>/trace.json (M7b), docs/progress/M8a/<city>/trace.json (M8a) and docs/progress/M8b/<city>/trace.json (M8b on M8a), docs/progress/M8d/<city>/trace.json (M8d) and docs/progress/M8c/<city>/trace.json (M8c on M8d), docs/progress/M11/<city>/trace.json (M11) and docs/progress/M9/<city>/trace.json (M11 on M9), docs/progress/M12/<city>/trace.json (M12 on M9 and M11), docs/progress/M10/<city>/trace.json (M10 on M12, M9 and M11). blockout_plans change with M9 (tunnel geometry) and not with M11 (the layer adds no blockout geometry) nor with M12 (no sample has a stack); they change with M10 (block corners and the props and plants, which draw on stable ids). tests/test_roads.py asserts them on every run. blockout_plans: sha256 of each sample's blockout_plan.json (citygen blockout, M4), asserted by tests/test_blockout.py; the plan is the same bytes on every machine, Blender only draws it. terrain_cities (M13 on M10): sha256 of the hilly sample's city_model.json (cities/cragmouth), asserted by tests/test_terrain.py with its blockout plan under blockout_plans; the flat samples, the pinned and the stack demo are byte-identical to M10 (M13 changes nothing on a city without terrain; their reports gain the five terrain checks, passing with nothing to check); traces in docs/progress/M13/<city>/trace.json. cragmouth's blockout plan changes with M15 (one object per retaining wall, named by its id, for the Unreal exporter's keys; the model is the same). Greyhook reshape (its coastline made more natural and interesting: a peninsula that fans out into headlands, coast.headlands): peninsula_city's model and blockout plan change, the four other samples, the pinned demo and the stack demo are unchanged; produced on the M4 Mac. deck_cities (M14 on M13): sha256 of the layered sample's city_model.json (cities/vesper_bay_decks, Vesper Bay with a deck over Highcrest), asserted by tests/test_decks.py with its blockout plan under blockout_plans; every city without decks is byte-identical to M13 (the new level and deck fields are left out of the JSON at their defaults; their reports gain no checks, the five deck checks run only when a city has a deck). Stage 1 fixes (after M15): cragmouth's model and blockout plan change (a junction of local roads is level on its grade lines along each leg out to the junction polygon's edge, past its curb and sidewalk corners, so its roads meet at one height there: more retaining walls on the hills, the same deepest cut and fill); vesper_bay_decks' model and blockout plan change (the deck's streets and ramps carry their district in district_ids, so the blockout joins them per district: d03.deck_road.<tile>, d03.deck_sidewalk.<tile>); every other sample is byte-identical; produced on the M4 Mac. M21 (cyberpunk massing) on M17: every sample's model and blockout plan change (tower, slab and megabuilding tower forms; true arcs cut at 1 cm chord sag in place of 12 to 32-gons, megasite circles and ovals included; the 150 m neighbor rule; megabuilding open decks only where both towers reach them; a cluster's podium piece under its tower; skybridges keeping stage 2's corridor margins and clear of traced buildings; sky tube portals under a tower's shaft; District.variety in the filled spec); produced on Windows 11 x86_64, where the earlier goldens reproduced the Mac's byte for byte. M16 (water and ground detail, on M17 and M21): every sample's model and blockout plan change on purpose: the water bodies gain depth_m, bed and flow (the sea its exposure), the banks and the ground cover are two new collections, nothing else in a model moves (each is its M21 model byte for byte with those fields and collections left out); the blockout draws the water at -1.5 m on a flat city (the quay deck height under the ground), beds per tile by depth, banks and the ground cover by kind in place of the open spaces at the ground, bridge piers from the bed, and lists swim boxes for the Unreal exporter; produced on the Windows PC (whose citygen models match the Mac's), Mac = x86 waits for the deferred determinism check. M19 (transit structures) on M18, M16 and M21: every sample's model and blockout plan change again (supports evenly spaced under the line, portal frames with cap beams, cantilever bents, piers, sky tube masts; sky tubes through a tower only at a station, a tube whose host tower another line takes out routed again without it; 6 m side clearance, 8 m over roads, 6.5 m over raised roads and other lines; default altitudes of elevated rail and monorail up; elevated rail cable spans up to 400 m); cragmouth's model changes by its metro's empty attrs.spans; produced on Windows 11 x86_64. M20 (props, plants and signs) on M19, M18, M16 and M21: every sample's model and blockout plan change on purpose: props and plants on the surfaces the model defines (a road's deck, the quay deck at the ground, the water, a wall at a height it has, a facade's floor) and under what is over them, nothing on the ground in a road's fill; neon billboards, banners and holo-boards on the facades and over the roofs as sign slots (District.signage), the roof billboards lit; the large ads as instanced prototypes in the blockout; produced on Windows 11 x86_64. Park paths fix (after M19): every sample's model and blockout plan change on purpose: park paths run on open land to the nearest point of a walkway beside their open space (the walkways split there), passages to enclosed open spaces, sidewalk corners on the right of way, every ground walkway led round the lots, entrance, gate and station links that reach a walkway with no building between; produced on the Windows PC, Mac = x86 waits for the deferred determinism check. Sky tube fixes (issues #94 and #97, after run-through 2): the models of the samples with sky tubes (delta_megacity, nexus_city, peninsula_city, vesper_bay, vesper_bay_decks) change on purpose: their sky tube supports are plain pylons by default (form column, no mast_top_m or stays; transit.sky_tube.supports: mast gives M19's masts back record for record), their tube pieces carry the line's rings (attrs.rings, evenly spaced along the whole line, lit by the frequency lit_rings_every, 1 by default) and their lines attrs.support_style and attrs.rings; their blockout plans change by the masts' legs and stays left off; archipelago_free_port and cragmouth (no sky tubes) are byte-identical; produced on Windows 11 x86_64. Barriers fix (#95, after the park paths fix): every sample's model and blockout plan change on purpose where a quay railing crossed a junction, a crosswalk or a road's carriageway, or a highway's median barrier prop a junction or a crosswalk (those props are left out, the props after them renumbered); nothing else in a model moves; produced on the Windows PC, Mac = x86 waits for the deferred determinism check. Access fixes (#86, #87, #91, after the barriers fix): the models and blockout plans of the cities with an open space or an entrance that had no way in, or a deck column the fill-in dropped, change on purpose: vesper_bay (a loop's infield park joins its neighbor park's path under the loop ramp; a 3 m gateway through the freight terminal's shed for its walled-in gate house and office), vesper_bay_decks (the same gateway, a strip park and the loop's infield join their neighbors' paths, a deck column on a thin strip the fill-in dropped, so its first layout passes), cragmouth (a roadless piece boxed in by canals and a viaduct is a green verge, a pocket park joins its neighbor's path) and peninsula_city (a park between the water and a megasite gets a path along the shore to a street's end); archipelago_free_port, delta_megacity and nexus_city are byte-identical; produced on the Windows PC, Mac = x86 waits for the deferred determinism check. Moorings fix (#113, after the access fixes): every sample's model and blockout plan change on purpose: boats moor past their quay's band (width_m across the quay's line, half of it over the water, as the blockout and AG7 draw it; on main every boat's hull lay in it, a basin's wholly under it), their hull clear of every quay band and 1 m off the waterway's shore, a few boats with no room for that left out (Vesper Bay 49 to 46); nothing but the boats moves; produced on the M4 Mac, Mac = x86 waits for the deferred determinism check.
